description: This file contains Pydantic schema definitions for various components of an Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, including document chunking, query analysis, retrieval, answer synthesis, claim verification, query decomposition, and meta-cognitive schemas.

classes.name: Chunk
classes.description: Represents a single document chunk with id, text, and metadata.

classes.name: ChunkList
classes.description: A list of document chunks with total count.

classes.name: QueryAnalysis
classes.description: Analyzes the complexity and type of a query.

classes.name: SubQuestion
classes.description: Represents a decomposed sub-question with priority.

classes.name: RankedChunk
classes.description: A document chunk with an associated relevance score.

classes.name: SearchTerms
classes.description: Structured list of key terms for targeted retrieval.

classes.name: RetrievalResult
classes.description: Contains retrieval chunks and strategy used.

classes.name: DraftAnswer
classes.description: A draft answer with confidence and missing info gaps.

classes.name: Gap
classes.description: Details of an information gap with priority.

classes.name: GapList
classes.description: Wrapper for a list of gaps.

classes.name: Claim
classes.description: An atomic factual claim with id, text, and type.

classes.name: ClaimList
classes.description: Wrapper for a list of claims.

classes.name: VerificationResult
classes.description: Verification status for a claim, including confidence and quote IDs.

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Source reference with chunk id, quote, and optional page number.

classes.name: SubQuestions
classes.description: A list of decomposed sub-questions.

classes.name: RefinementQuery
classes.description: A query for refinement iteration with focus area.

classes.name: RefinementQueryList
classes.description: A list of refinement queries.

classes.name: VerifiedAnswer
classes.description: Final answer with provenance, citations, confidence, and gaps.

classes.name: CompletenessScore
classes.description: Wrapper for completeness assessment score.

classes.name: QuerySemantics
classes.description: Meta-cognitive schema for query understanding.

classes.name: PrecisionRequirements
classes.description: Schema for match precision and reasoning.

classes.name: RetrievalPlan
classes.description: Schema for dynamically composed retrieval strategy.

classes.name: MatchQuality
classes.description: Assessment of chunk-query relevance and quality.

classes.name: DraftAnswerWithEntities
classes.description: Draft answer with extracted entities and confidence.

classes.name: DriftAnalysis
classes.description: Semantic drift detection between query and answer.

classes.name: AlignmentVerdict
classes.description: Validation of whether answer addresses the query.

classes.name: FinalConfidence
classes.description: Schema for adaptive confidence calibration.
